brief:
The Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza reported seven deaths over the past 24 hours as of September 9, 2026, Eye on Palestine said. The casualties included two people killed in fresh incidents, one person who died from wounds sustained earlier, and four bodies recovered from rubble. Hospitals admitted 25 injured patients during the same period.

Health officials noted that many additional victims remain unreachable, trapped beneath collapsed structures across Gaza. The exact circumstances surrounding the deaths and injuries were not detailed in the ministry's report.
